shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.ts src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(orchestrator): aggregate usage across all tool rounds

Replace single-round usage retention with cumulative totals across all
provider calls in a turn. Introduces sumUsage helper that sums token
counts across rounds while gracefully handling rounds without usage
reports. The hook receives aggregated usage instead of final-round-only
usage, enabling deployers to accurately record costs for tool-heavy turns.

Changes lastUsage from single value to roundUsages array; afterModelResponse
hook now receives sumUsage(roundUsages) instead of lastUsage. Preserves
existing behavior for single-round turns and turns with no usage reports.
EOF
)"
git add .lore/dod.md && git commit -m "update: mark facets 1-3 complete in dod.md"
